audit_items.proof_trace: UpgradeState calls UpgradeToFulu for every slot in FULU_FORK_EPOCH without checking state.Version(). When called on already-upgraded Fulu state, line upgrade.go:118 sets Fork.PreviousVersion to FuluForkVersion instead of preserving ElectraForkVersion, corrupting fork history.
audit_items.attack_scenario: At FULU_FORK_EPOCH slot 0, state upgrades correctly (PreviousVersion=Electra, CurrentVersion=Fulu). At slot 1 in same epoch, UpgradeToFulu re-executes, overwriting Fork.PreviousVersion from Electra to Fulu. Fork history corruption breaks light client sync and fork choice validation.
